'''WED-9-M1'''<ref name="By the numbers" /> was a [[WED Treadwell repair droid]] that was present in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine]]<ref name="By the numbers" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="IV Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The WED-9-M1 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The droid was first identified in "Every Droid in Star Wars" a video released in [[2019]] by the ''Star Wars'' Kids [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.<ref name="By the numbers" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was originally used by the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.<ref name="SWCCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=WED-9-M1 "Bantha" Droid}}</ref>
